name: ultimate-skills
description: A curated, deduplicated marketplace of 68 Claude Code skills in 7 plugins (engineering, product, design, writing, security, security-cc-by-sa, research), distilled from 34 community skill repos with per-skill provenance. Most plugins are MIT/Apache-2.0; security-cc-by-sa is share-alike (CC-BY-SA-4.0) and research is non-commercial (CC-BY-NC-4.0).

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Production engineering loop (MIT/Apache-2.0): spec, plan, build incrementally or via reviewed subagents, TDD, debugging from a red feedback loop, verify-before-done, code review, iterate a PR to green, harden, optimize, Postgres schemas and safe migrations, MCP server building, long-horizon agent prompts.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product management (MIT/Apache-2.0): discovery, positioning, Rumelt strategy kernel and red-teaming, prioritization, PRDs, evidence-labelled competitor analysis, pricing, SaaS unit economics, A/B analysis, analysis QA before sharing, and metrics.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Anti-slop design and frontend craft (MIT/Apache-2.0): marketing-page direction, product-UI/dashboard design, real image generation (OpenAI / Gemini) with image-first concepts and image-to-code, redesign critique, motion rules, lint-style UI review, WCAG 2.2 audits, SVG icon sets, HTML slide decks, production UI engineering.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Prose (MIT/Apache-2.0): conclusion-first decision documents with the Minto Pyramid (plus a structure audit), Seven Sweeps copy editing for marketing copy, and a humanizer pass that strips AI-sounding patterns without adding or losing facts.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Authorized security auditing and pentesting (MIT/Apache-2.0): code-grounded threat modeling, read-only static vulnerability scanning, adversarial triage of any scanner's findings, GitHub Actions review, agent skill/plugin scanning, LLM app audits, and scope-gated web pentesting.

plugins.name: security-cc-by-sa
plugins.description: Share-alike security testing (CC-BY-SA-4.0, isolated from the permissive plugins): supply-chain dependency risk auditing for npm/PyPI/Go and variant analysis with CodeQL/Semgrep starters. Adapted from Trail of Bits.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Rigorous research and academic writing pipelines: deep research, multi-agent paper writing, peer-review simulation, full research orchestrator. NOTE: CC-BY-NC-4.0, non-commercial use only.
